name: Template Literals
equipment: A computer with a JS runtime (a browser console, Node.js, or an online REPL like replit.com)
instructions: Template literals let you embed variables directly inside a string using backticks.
const greeting = `Hello, ${name}! You are ${age} years old.`;
console.log(greeting); // Hello, Ada! You are 30 years old.
Type the example into a real file (or console/REPL), run it, then modify it until you understand why it behaves that way.
